limitations: This manifest describes static package/executable evidence, not a recorded original-game trace.
Native bone IDs must be resolved through original bone tables; they are not animation channel or Unity transform indices.
Source point lookup and facing conversion are native; Unity retargeted bone transforms are an adaptation that needs visual validation.
Other properties, collision-driven character effects, start/end event tables, flags and override item variants are outside this initial 0x802E manifest.
An effect registry binding does not establish how FindEffectsNative combines customization overrides.
Unity uses retargeted rig world points and displayed actor facing; comparison with an original-game capture remains required.
The native +10 Unreal-unit Z spawn offset is converted to +0.1 metre world up for mesh emitter origins; PM_CharacterBone uses the zero-offset resolved rig bone.
Versus queues acted-frame events until its actors are posed; multiple simulation ticks retain all events but use the next displayed pose.
Random atlas selection, custom sockets, omitted material operations and unsupported emitter variants remain listed in conversion-report.json.
